public_domain_references.asv: As many as desire to make a fair show in the flesh, they compel you to be circumcised; only that they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.
public_domain_references.kjv: As many as desire to make a fair shew in the flesh, they constrain you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.

pob.text: For not even those who are circumcised themselves keep the law[a], but they want you to be circumcised so that they may boast in your flesh.

spob.text: For even those who are circumcised do not themselves obey the law. But they want you to be circumcised so they can boast about your circumcision.

public_domain_references.bsb: For the circumcised do not even keep the law themselves, yet they want you to be circumcised that they may boast in your flesh.
public_domain_references.web: For even they who receive circumcision don’t keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, so that they may boast in your flesh.
public_domain_references.asv: For not even they who receive circumcision do themselves keep the law; but they desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.
public_domain_references.kjv: For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law; but desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.

pob.text: But far be it from me to boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus the Messiah[a], through which the world has been crucified to me[b], and I to the world.

spob.text: But I will never boast about anything except the cross of our Lord Jesus the Messiah.[a] Through that cross,[b] the world has been crucified to me, and I have been crucified to the world.

public_domain_references.bsb: But as for me, may I never boast, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.
public_domain_references.web: But far be it from me to boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.
public_domain_references.asv: But far be it from me to glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world hath been crucified unto me, and I unto the world.
public_domain_references.kjv: But God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.

pob.text: For neither circumcision counts for anything[a], nor uncircumcision[b], but a new creation.

spob.text: For whether someone is circumcised or uncircumcised does not count for anything. What matters is a new creation.

public_domain_references.bsb: For neither circumcision nor uncircumcision means anything. What counts is a new creation.
public_domain_references.web: For in Christ Jesus neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.
public_domain_references.asv: For neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.
public_domain_references.kjv: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.

pob.text: And as many as will walk by this rule—peace be upon them and mercy[c][b][a], and upon the Israel of God.

spob.text: May peace and mercy be upon all who keep in step with this standard, and upon the Israel of God.[a][b]

public_domain_references.bsb: Peace and mercy to all who walk by this rule, even to the Israel of God.
public_domain_references.web: As many as walk by this rule, peace and mercy be on them, and on God’s Israel.
public_domain_references.asv: And as many as shall walk by this rule, peace [be] upon them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.
public_domain_references.kjv: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace [be] on them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.

pob.text: From now on let no one cause me trouble[a], for I bear the marks of Jesus on my body.

spob.text: From now on, no one should cause me any more trouble, because I carry the marks of Jesus on my body.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: From now on let no one cause me trouble, for I bear on my body the marks of Jesus.
public_domain_references.web: From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.
public_domain_references.asv: Henceforth let no man trouble me; for I bear branded on my body the marks of Jesus.
public_domain_references.kjv: From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.

pob.text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit[a], brothers[b]. Amen.

spob.text: Brothers[b], may the grace of our Lord Jesus the Messiah[a] be with your spirit. Amen.

public_domain_references.bsb: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.
public_domain_references.web: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.
public_domain_references.asv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brethren. Amen.
